cohort: Nulliparas delivering at ≥39(0/7) weeks, 250 with stage 1 hypertension and 250 with normotension
finding: In nulliparas, stage 1 hypertension is an independent risk factor for unplanned cesarean.
mod_finding: In nulliparas, stage 1 hypertension is an independent risk factor for unplanned cesarean delivery.
